# h3_lbs (Data Source)

Lists the load balancers of a project. Requires API-key (HMAC) access to the load balancer API; as of 0.3.0 h3lb is reachable only from the console (backend gap), so calls fail with 401/404 until it is published on api.h3llo.cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_lbs" "all" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID); the provider default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `load_balancers` (Attributes List) Load balancers of the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancers))

<a id="nestedatt--load_balancers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancers`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String) Balancing algorithm.
- `eip_id` (String) Elastic IP of the load balancer (LB Basic); null for legacy lb-svc load balancers.
- `endpoint` (String) Endpoint.
- `external_ip` (String) Public IP address.
- `id` (String) Load balancer ID.
- `listener` (Attributes List) Listeners. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancers--listener))
- `name` (String) Name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `status` (String) `PENDING`, `CREATING`, `RUNNING`, `DELETING` or `FAILED`.
- `subnet_name` (String) Subnet the load balancer runs in.
- `targets` (List of String) Target IP addresses.

<a id="nestedatt--load_balancers--listener"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancers.listener`

Read-Only:

- `port` (Number) Public port.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol.
- `target_port` (Number) Target port.
